test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7115eab8728047081bcd6c5a6957aeda49fccdb08bb19a18f76a2234369c556b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcf6f856fab0cde2bebd718164065bd653cf0306f40ce9474cf3e1c3fb47d230.png] 

__**(3 + 5 + 13)**__ ÷ 3 = 7 

__**21 ÷ 3**__ = 7

7 = 7

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d729a5e4f54aa26b72303cb41fd808209eff14a6da41a7ef2292b4ddadb6a7ff.png] 

__(9 + 8 + 7)__ ÷ 3 = 8 

__24 ÷ 3__ = 8

8 = 8

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e0b1e02338836d4dd5292c47d6c00b01f5f3e57b1a27be154509547aa30fa04.png] 

__(2 + 3 + 4)__ ÷ 3 = ? 

__9 ÷ 3__ = ?

**3 = ?**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
